units.source_text: 尽管如此，在西阵的纺织作坊街，特别是在小巷里，一看就明白，这些所谓作坊是以零星的家庭手工业居多。

en.t: Even so, in Nishijin's weaving workshop streets, especially in the narrow lanes, it was clear at a glance that these so-called workshops were mostly small-scale household handicraft operations.

units.source_text: 他们是紧跟这次统制措施的。

en.t: They were keeping closely in step with these control measures.
